violation_type.title: Care Requirements for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Routines maintained (26 TAC §746.2601(1))
violation_type.short_title: Care Requirements for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Routines maintained
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation staff did not provide routine care for a 4-year-old child, after returning to the classroom and after being left unsupervised outside. The staff did not wash his hands and did not change his soiled diaper and clothing.

finding_variants.text: The operation staff did not provide routine care for a 4-year-old child, after returning to the classroom and after being left unsupervised outside. The staff did not wash his hands and did not change his soiled diaper and clothing.
Based on the information gathered during the investigation, a caregiver did not change a child's diaper because she was not aware he wore a diaper.
Child was sent home with feces in pants. Child was not asked if they needed to go to the restroom or checked by caregiver to see if they were clean prior to being sent home.
A child was left in soiled clothing for several hours.
Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, children have not been given prompt access to the bathrooms and has resulted in preventable accidents in the classroom.
